title: Android XML CheckBox: button drawable selector
purpose: Check a custom Android XML button drawable selector on a CheckBox, including checked, unchecked, disabled and RTL states.
changes: Added solid-shape button drawables and supported state selectors. The example uses a blue circle when checked, amber square when unchecked and gray circle when disabled.
steps: Scroll to Android XML button drawable selector. Checked circle should have a blue circle, Unchecked square an amber square, and Disabled circle a gray circle.
Tap the first two rows. Each indicator should change between the blue circle and amber square as its checked state changes; the row labels stay in place.
Tap the disabled row and check that its gray indicator stays unchanged.

Turn on Right-to-left layout near the top. The indicators should move to the right, and the enabled rows should still toggle. Choose OK if the steps work, or Reject with the failing step, what you saw and your device.
expected: The XML selector supplies the visible indicator for each state. Enabled rows toggle; the disabled row stays gray; RTL reverses indicator placement.
limits: Only solid rectangular or circular XML shapes up to 32 dp, supported state selectors and @null are covered. Bitmap, vector and animated drawables, tint compositing and exact Android device appearance remain open.

references.scope: Compound button drawable and checked states.

validation: 144 Android XML importer tests passed, including shape drawable selector import.
Four Rust checkbox tests passed, including custom checked, unchecked, disabled and RTL drawable states and pointer toggling.
